verdictTable.decisiveDefect: Two of the four selfHelpStopConditions the committed track registry records for trackId ar-act531 are absent from the packet, and the packet tells the participant there is no filing fee while shipping two forms that each recite, on their face, that the defendant has paid the filing fees mandated by A.C.A. § 16-90-1419 — a recital the instructions never name or reconcile.

The packet tells the participant that no committed record it binds states a filing fee or a fee waiver for this route, while the compiled Mississippi profile it binds by exact SHA-256 carries a section titled 'Filing Fee', category 'fees', stating that Miss. Code Ann. § 99-19-72 sets a $150 filing fee for each petition to expunge an offense under § 99-19-71 — and the packet's own petition page tells the participant that this route's operative provision 'appears in both Sec. 99-15-26(5) and Sec. 99-19-71(4)'. The packet builds the bridge to the sibling statute and then leaves the fee on the far side of it unnamed.

Three committed records — the hash-bound legal decision research-track-decision:al-olr, the route-obligation census entry for obligation:research-decision-route:AL:al-olr, and the packet-family build worklist — all record this route's participant-facing deliverable as the AOC Order of Limited Relief packet comprising the sworn petition AND a proposed order. The packet delivers the petition alone, with no proposed order and no declared refusal of one anywhere in build-findings.json, the source receipt or the participant instructions; the instructions instead assert 'This packet is one form.'

whatIMeasured.environment: node scripts/verify-packet-build-environment.mjs run first in this worktree. Master Library mounted and verified: 499 files, 329 PDFs, 51 jurisdictions, 24 sampled index entries byte-exact. The D source packs at private/source-imports/rcap-d-source-packs-2026-08-12 were consulted as a second custody and every official form this lane touched is present in both. The only environment FAILs were worktree_clean and private_is_git_ignored, both caused by this reader's own read-only symlinks (private/ and node_modules/ point at the main worktree); neither was committed.
whatIMeasured.hashes: Every SHA-256 recomputed from the bytes on disk with node:crypto. 44 declared hash bindings were checked across rendered-artifacts.json, product-wiring.json proposedRepresentation components, acceptance receipts, source receipts' committedRecords and documents blocks, and the Master Library files themselves. 43 agreed. The one disagreement is recorded under contradictions below.
whatIMeasured.pageCounts: Loaded with pdf-lib (1.17.1) from the fixture bytes and differenced against every pageManifest. Six of the eight families carry a pageManifest and all six differenced to zero, with packetPage contiguous from 1 and no repeat. The two official-pdf-fill families (ar-act531-set, al-olr) carry a rendered-artifacts schema variant with no pageManifest and no pageCount, so page order was proved against the source form page counts recorded in their receipts and then confirmed by per-page text extraction.
whatIMeasured.geometry: pdftotext -bbox-layout on all 20 fixtures. Every same-baseline word pair (|yMin difference| <= 2pt, x-overlap > 0.2pt) was CLASSIFIED rather than counted. 78 overlapping pairs exist in total, all of them on the two official-pdf-fill families, and every one is a value word sitting on the underscore rule that receives it — the intended rendering. Zero value-over-value collisions were found on any family. The six composed families produced zero overlapping pairs at all.
whatIMeasured.completeness: node scripts/rcap-packet-completeness/verify-packet-completeness.mjs --family <id> was run in this container for each of the eight. All eight returned PASS_COMPLETE with all nine counters zero. Those counters were recomputed here, not read from any builder's report — and three of the eight families failed anyway, which is the point of scoring the fifteen obligations separately.
whatIMeasured.textReadBack: Every packet's rendered text was extracted and read against its own participant-instructions.md, its bound registry or decision record, and the compiled state profile. That read-back is what found all five obligation failures; none of them is visible in any counter.

whatICouldNotMeasure: NO PIXEL WAS INSPECTED. Artifact blobs are not downloadable from this container: the proxy refuses blob storage at 403. All eight families carry an acceptanceReceipt with verdict RASTER_PASS, and each is cited below by run, job and artifact id with the canonical hash it binds; for all eight that bound hash was re-derived here from the fixture bytes and still equals it. That proves the receipt still describes the bytes on disk. It does not prove anything about how a page looks.

pdftotext -bbox-layout reports only extractable text. It cannot see raster ink, vector rules, field borders, images, or any glyph without extractable text. Every CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP pass in this return is a statement about text geometry and nothing more.

private/Nationwide Record Clearing is NOT mounted in this container. No path beginning 'LegalEase <State>/' was readable. Nothing in this return relies on one, and no obligation was scored against a Nationwide path.

Whether the legal propositions the packets state are correct law is outside a verifier's reach. Where a finding touches a legal question — whether Miss. Code Ann. § 99-19-72 reaches a § 99-15-26(5) petition, whether A.C.A. § 16-90-1419 fees survive Act 1460, whether AL Form C-10-CRIMINAL is the payment-plan vehicle for a chapter 12-26 petition — this return records the question and refuses to answer it.

contradictionsWithRecordsAlreadyInTheRep.what: 24 source receipts across the repository bind data/record-clearing/legal-design-packet-set-manifests.json at sha256 80d88d69dc5710b9a763abb31c6864069f9bb6d74b942c5e5849925144693ffa and declare allSourcesExact true. At cd48fc14e that file hashes to 563147bf8431e5d3bcfc2b75e07307ae706b2d086d4f302e66fee9300b89588d, 3677637 bytes.
contradictionsWithRecordsAlreadyInTheRep.whatItActuallyMeans: The file hashed to the declared value at commit ee5bdb5b5 and was changed by 77f24687c ('Execute four owner determinations…'). Diffing that version against this head, exactly one packetSets entry moved: ca-diversion-seal-set. The entries the other 23 receipts rely on — ak-mistaken-identity-set among them — are byte-identical. So no relied-on statement moved, and this reader scored SOURCE_IDENTITY PASS for ak-mistaken-identity-set on that proof rather than on the receipt's word.
contradictionsWithRecordsAlreadyInTheRep.whyItIsStillWorthCaptainsTime: A receipt that declares an exact digest which no longer holds cannot be checked cheaply by anyone downstream; the next reader has to do the git archaeology this one did. The honest fix is a receipt refresh across the 24, or a per-entry digest instead of a whole-file digest so an unrelated edit does not invalidate 24 bindings at once.
contradictionsWithRecordsAlreadyInTheRep.notFiledAsARepairAssignment: Deliberately. It is not a defect of any packet and filing 24 repair rows would pollute the queue. It is reported here for the Captain to route as receipt hygiene.

contradictionsWithRecordsAlreadyInTheRep.what: dc_yra_set_aside-set's rendered filing-instructions page prints a section headed 'THE PAGES IN THIS SET' that lists only dc_yra_set_aside-primary-filing-1 — it does not name the filing-instructions component the list is printed on. participant-instructions.md for the same family lists both components, and the petition page tells the participant to 'see the filing instructions in this packet'.
contradictionsWithRecordsAlreadyInTheRep.whyItIsNotScoredAFailureHere: The generator emits that list from the packet-set manifest's declared components, and the DC manifest declares one. The same shape appears in other families built by other scripts — scripts/build-census-v1-rcap-tn-custom-pleading.mjs emits single-component 'THE PAGES IN THIS SET' lists for families that also render an added process page. It is a repository-wide convention, not a defect built into this packet, and failing dc_yra_set_aside-set for it would mean failing every family that shares the convention. It is also an understatement rather than a denial, so DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001-A4 is not engaged on its terms.
contradictionsWithRecordsAlreadyInTheRep.whatCaptainMayWantToDecide: Whether 'THE PAGES IN THIS SET' should enumerate the rendered component set or the manifest-declared component set. A participant counting their pages against that list will come up short by the instruction sheet itself.

whereTheFailuresCameFrom.observation: All five obligation failures are of the two kinds the determination predicts, and none of them is visible in any counter, any build-findings file, or any report.
whereTheFailuresCameFrom.SELF_HELP_STOP: 3 of the 5. In each case a committed record — the track registry for ar-act531, the hash-bound legal decision for al-olr — records a stop condition that never reaches the participant. The method that found them: read the record's conditions one at a time, then grep the .md AND the extracted fixture text for each condition's distinguishing terms. ar-act531-set is the only one of the eight families with no immigration or citizenship stop condition anywhere in it; the other seven all carry one.
whereTheFailuresCameFrom.FEE_AND_WAIVER: 2 of the 5, and both are sibling traps rather than missing statements. The five families that pass this obligation pass it by naming the near-miss and disposing of it out loud — CO refuses the JDF 612 figure by name, AK correct-record refuses three Alaska fee-table lines by name, ms-misd-addl-set refuses the $150 under § 99-19-72 by name. The two that fail are silent about a figure their own bound record or their own delivered page puts in front of the participant.
whereTheFailuresCameFrom.COMPONENT_SET: 1 of the 5, and it is the absence of a declared refusal rather than the absence of a component per se. No AOC proposed order exists in either custody; the defect is that nothing in the family says so.
